limits: Node API timings exclude React/SVG, native rendering, physical iPhone hardware and widget scheduling.
Warm pose results are cache-hit calls, not eight fresh rasterizations per screen refresh.
Timing samples are repeated evaluations of fixed fixtures, not independent players or a population confidence interval.
Only blueprint occupancy is observed here; other limits are declared program limits, not per-cache telemetry.
